Name: Shirtless Alex Updated
Author: Brukob
Description:
Alex spent months building up his muscles and now decided to go shirtless. This is an update to [url=https://nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1186]Blue_Starkiller's Shirtless Alex[/url] and [url=https://nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/399]JepMZ's Shirtless Alex portraits[/url], along with a few resprites of mine to Alex' hair and sleep time. Alex will only wear a shirt for his 10 heart event at the restaurant.

Please also support the authors of the original mods!

[size=5]Install[/size]
[list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*][url=https://nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Install the latest version of Content Patcher[/url].
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]

[size=5]How to use[/size]
Unzipping the mod into the Mods folder is enough, but if you want to configure the mod in-game you can use the GenericModConfigMenu Mod Options:

[list]
[*]Go to Options > Scroll to the bottom and click Mod Options > Choose Shirtless Alex
[/list]
You can also use the Main Menu Mod Options or manually configure it in the config.json file if you dont have GMCM.


[size=5]Compatibility[/size]
[list]
[*]Works with Stardew Valley 1.5 on Linux/Mac/Windows.
[*]If you play with any other outfits content pack that changes Alex' sprites like Seasonal Outfits, you'll have to disable his sprites:
[list]
[*]Find the content.json file in the Seasonal Outfits folder. Open this with any text editor.
[*]Do a ctrl-F through the file to find any lines where "Alex" is mentioned. There should be a bunch of these appearing in lists with
other characters, always "Characters/Alex" or "Portraits/Alex".[*]Every time you find one of these, delete it from the list. Make sure each list still ends with a " and a ,
[*]Once you're done, use the validator tool at [url=https://smapi.io/json]https://smapi.io/json[/url] to check for any errors in your formatting. Choose "Content Patcher"
from the drop down and paste the entire text of the revised content.json file inside. Validate the file.[*]No errors? Good to go! Save your changes. You have just created a custom version of the Seasonal Outfits mod that will not make any changes to Alex.
[/list][/list]
